lines: Below are resources for accessing local surplus land.
Sign up to receive notices of availability here.
Entities interested in becoming certified as a Housing Sponsor can follow the directions on CalHFA's website.
View developers that notified HCD of their interest in surplus local public lands (Updated: 10/31/2025).

For developers currently on the list, you may submit a request to update your information on the Update for Developers Interest List page. To unsubscribe from the Developers Interest List, visit the Unsubscribe from Developers Interest List page.
For information on utilizing the Developers Interest List, review the User Aide (PDF).
View Notices of Available Locally-Owned Surplus Land Map. This map includes notices of availability received via the Surplus Land Act Portal.
View list of notices of availability received (updated weekly).

In accordance with Assembly Bill 1255 (Robert Rivas, 2019), every California city and county is required to have a central inventory of surplus land and must report this to HCD on the Housing Element Annual Progress Report (APR) form by April 1 of each year. To learn more about this form, please see the Annual Progress Reports. HCD, in turn, provides the information to DGS to include in a statewide map.
Access the map of local surplus sites and housing element sites for information on potential development opportunities.
For further information, see the Housing and Local Land Development Opportunities Map Webinar (February 24, 2023) and presentation slides (PDF).
